notes: PLEA test run 2 on Sepolia (chain 11155111): the accepted launch #1242 adaptation plus the four retained changes, deployed unchanged. The factory deploys PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, Laureates, PleaDistributor and PleaLaunch in this order, with zero ETH, in one transaction. Atomic deployment is required: PLEA.setLauncher accepts either the deploy-transaction flag or PLEA's deployment block, so PleaLaunch's constructor must register the system contracts in the same transaction before any other caller can. Constructor arguments, in declaration order: PLEA(owner = $owner). CabalGate(PLEA, Intake v2 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82, oracle fee asset 0x44a1cd38474fb1748400e7deb5f8d786cce3f89a, TestIMD 0x2B69099E59b05901faA1DD164fabf098bf831E82, oracle signer 0x5598Aa9146215Bc13eb26f2c692Ad1461Fd32982, season 18000 s, dead-man 118800 s). Seasons(PLEA, CabalGate, TestIMD); it reads SEASON from the earlier CabalGate. Laureates(PLEA). PleaDistributor(PLEA, owner = $owner). PleaLaunch(PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, Laureates, PleaDistributor, Sepolia Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0xE03A1074c86CFeDd5C142C4F04F1a1536e203543, TestIMD, imd/acc launch #1294 Stacker 0x0457276d7b036818b3eddc1a4a3fceda61e9314d, credit gas 1300000, START 1792162800); it reads the owner from PLEA and commits it into the hook init code hash. Only the two owner arguments use $owner; nothing is owned by msg.sender or tx.origin, and no constructor calls a live external contract. Retained behaviour: PLEA.init mints 88% to the hook, 2% to Seasons and 10% to PleaDistributor; each of the first four seasons pays 5,000,000 PLEA to its qualifying top 10 and burns the unpaid rest; flushToWall burns what is left and nobody can withdraw it; the cap decays to its floor in 25 days; POOL4-style wall placement guard; pleas ask Intake v2 with requestWithFailure, onPleaFailure only clears our own still-pending plea, emits PleaFailed and never moves value, and expire() stays as the fallback. Fees, plea timings, panel 30, quorum 17, 5-hour seasons, 33-hour dead-man, START and credit gas are unchanged. PleaHook is not a manifest entry: after launch, PleaLaunch.deployHook(salt, initCode) deploys it with CREATE2 using a salt mined off chain for FLAGS, then PLEA.init mints the supply; seed() opens trading (owner any time, anyone from START). PLEA supply is zero after this deployment. Gas: test/LaunchManifest.t.sol deploys exactly this manifest from an empty Sepolia chain and measured 17,246,276 gas, 469,060 over the 16,777,216 mainnet cap (PleaLaunch embeds PleaHook's creation code, so the accepted hook wall-guard revision adds to it); the test reports that margin and does not assert it, since Sepolia accepted launch #1242's 81.8M-gas deploy in one transaction. The deployment service's simulation of the real factory transaction is the authoritative gas check.
